tasks.short: Prepare reports documenting actual patient care activities.

steps.what: Verify patient identity and capture actual care activities, responses and unresolved documentation gaps
inputs: existing patient care entries and author timestamps

steps.what: Populate report headings and exact documented care events from the clinical record
Draft the care narrative and correct omissions against the complete clinical source set
outputs: complete corrected patient care report draft

loop.purpose: Draft variable care narrative without inferring undocumented care or outcomes
loop.input: nurse-checked care source set and factual report draft
loop.output: care narrative with entry-level source references and explicit gaps
loop.check: Nurse checks every assertion, chronology, care response, omission, negation and patient identity against original entries and corrects the narrative
loop.stop: Missing or conflicting care evidence or two failed corrections returns narrative writing to the nurse
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates fill exact fields first; variable multi-author narrative needs synthesis and complete nurse correction

steps.what: Approve the complete final care report, patient record and reporting period
inputs: complete corrected patient care report draft
outputs: approved final patient care report and record destination

steps.what: Commit the approved final care report to the approved clinical record
inputs: approved final patient care report and record destination
outputs: saved patient care report with author and version

tasks.design: Configure the {CLINICAL_RECORD} reporting template and exact event mapping first. OTHER denotes that clinical record. A bounded drafting loop synthesises only the remaining free-text care narrative. The nurse verifies actual care evidence, corrects the whole draft and approves the complete final report before its separate record commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Care information may be spread across dated entries and variable nursing notes; copying facts does not establish what happened.
tasks.enabler_now: Native report templates can reuse exact fields; source-grounded narrative drafting is possible subject to full clinician validation.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling contradictory entries, determining clinical relevance and detecting missing care remain nursing work.
tasks.human_edge: The nurse is accountable for an accurate account of care and patient response.
tasks.altitude: Patient care report preparation with clinical review retained.

evidence.claim: Clinical documentation products can draft notes for clinician validation; this supports a drafting capability, not this task saving.
Model knowledge: native reporting templates can reuse exact clinical fields where configured and authorised.

assumptions: All shares and retained effort are provisional design allocations, not measured nursing baselines. Existing native report generation receives no new saving; validate remaining manual work before rollout.

In s1 the nurse checks or enters patient_id, care_date/time, activity, performing_author, observed_response and unresolved_issue at full time. Other clinicians produce their own existing signed entries; no new uncounted documentation labour is assumed. Missing fields require manual clarification and report writing.

s2 maps exact events only. s3 retains 15 of its 25 baseline hours for full semantic checking and correction; s4 retains the separate final report approval. The model cannot infer performed care, diagnose, prescribe or silently resolve contradictions.

a1 applies to the complete s4 version and patient destination. Any correction requires renewed approval before commit. Access and clinical validation must be established; no external dispatch is included or claimed.
unknowns: Actual residual manual report work after current native features
Clinical record template and authorised draft interface
Correction effort on multi-author care histories
research_questions: Does a sample of actual care reports show enough remaining copying and narrative drafting to justify this configuration?

incremental.description: Audit report omissions and maintain approved clinical template mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final patient care report and correct patient record destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional central benefit is 20 exact-field copy hours, 10 narrative hours and 5 commit hours, less 2 upkeep = 33. Low halves only exact-field copying benefit and keeps narrative and commit manual: 10 minus 2 = 8.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reviewable care reporting beside clinical nursing responsibility.
role.ambitious_version: A nurse can inspect every report assertion against its actual care entry before approving the final record.
